reason: Attacked on the two fronts that could break it, and it held both. FRONT ONE, the novel. Every quotation site that carries this sentence hangs it on Tender Is the Night, and if it were there the notebook citation would be the wrong one. I did not take the verifier's word for the ruling-out: I pulled the complete English text of all three books of Tender Is the Night (fitzgerald.narod.ru/tend/orig_tender_01..03.html, about 730,000 characters) and counted. Switzerland appears six times, all in Book Two, and all six are other sentences: Switzerland was an island washed on one side by the waves of thunder around Gorizia; bring his daughter to Switzerland; a terrible thing for Switzerland if a cable broke; he had managed to get her to Switzerland; despite the overhanging mountains Switzerland was far away; plus one occurrence inside the site's Notes for Russian Readers. The string many things end does not occur anywhere in the novel. The novel is out, so the notebook is where the sentence lives. FRONT TWO, the locator. I fetched the section E page raw rather than through a summariser and read the entries in sequence: 332 is the genius definition, 333 is the Elspeth joke, 334 is Nervous system from Pthodemy Club (Dean Clark's), 335 is Switzerland is a country where very few things begin, but many things end., 336 is the snot machine. Wording matches the shipped line to the letter, including the comma before but and the closing full stop, and the entry sits exactly where the proposal put it. The same site's notebooks index states its text is Bruccoli's edition and says Edmund Wilson included sixty percent of the Notebooks entries in The Crack-Up (New York: New Directions, 1945), with alterations, so the edition named in the source line is the edition transcribed, and Bruccoli's is the only numbered one. Residual risk, stated plainly and not enough to refute: the printed leaf was not opened, so the number 335 rests on a transcription that names its edition rather than on the page itself; the source line already names the edition and editor, which is what the standard asks. OTHER CHECKS. Author: shipped.js gives f. scott fitzgerald at 0 of 3, not banned, nothing shipped and no near opening, and no other Fitzgerald stands among the month's verdicts, so the one-per-month rule is safe. Scope: published 1945 in part and 1978 entire, both before 1999; not scripture, film, lyric, proverb, business or oratory; nothing needing a warning. Tag: Diary is the nearest tag in the closed vocabulary for a writer's notebook, and the house has done this before, Leonardo da Vinci, Notebooks, no. 1177 landed in May under Diary with a note conceding Philosophy would serve. Source line: 133 characters, leads with the name, colon-free and dash-free, and it is honest about the section it comes from, Epigrams, Wise Cracks and Jokes, so the reader is told it is a wisecrack. Theme: many things end is impermanence said drily rather than bleakly, which is what a six in the morning card can carry.
